summary: Iteration 13 (frontend only): static + runtime verification of editable EXIF chips. Verified ExifChip.jsx (props, editing/draft state, Enter save / Escape cancel, trimmed value -> null on empty, all data-testids: exif-*, -editing, -input, -save, -cancel, conditional title tooltip), App.js wiring (EXIF label, three ExifChip instances with overridden/editable/onSave keyed by currentImagePath, empty entries deleted, setExifOverrides in usePersistedState), and storage.js (DEFAULT_STATE.exifOverrides + loadState fallback). Runtime: app loads with 0 console errors, EXIF label with correct title renders, all three chips render and are non-editable with no image selected (click does not enter edit mode). Regression pass: all 11 toolbar testids present with correct disabled states, Settings opens + Escape closes, Category Manager opens, Help modal open/close, Batch toggle reveals batch-select-controls.

ui_bugs.issue: Tooltip threshold (value.length > 22) does not match visual truncation (max-w-[16ch] + truncate). e.g. Cam chip displays 'e.g. Canon EOS ...' visually clipped but title attribute is undefined, so hover reveals nothing. Suggest threshold >= 16 chars or measure overflow (scrollWidth > clientWidth).

With no image selected the chips render the placeholder text ('e.g. 2024-08-14', 'e.g. Kenai, Alaska', 'e.g. Canon EOS R5') in the value slot, which can read as real metadata. Consider dimming/italicizing placeholder or showing em-dash when no image is loaded.

action_items: Fix ExifChip tooltip trigger so it fires whenever the value is visually truncated (16ch cap), not only >22 chars.
Optional: distinguish placeholder text from real EXIF values when no image is selected.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 1521 lines (>700) — consider splitting toolbar/modals into modules.
The three ExifChip onSave handlers in App.js are identical apart from the field key (DRY violation ~15 lines x3) — extract a single makeExifSaver(field) helper.

Pre-existing lint errors remain (no-empty blocks in App.js/BatchRenameModal/IconOverlay/ImageEditor/thumbCache, unescaped entity at App.js:1035, unused eslint-disable directives incl. ExifChip.jsx:21).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Edit-mode flow (exif-*-input / -save / -cancel, localStorage persistence of exifOverrides) could not be exercised at runtime because editable={!!currentImage} requires a File System Access picker selection, which is not automatable. It was verified statically only. All previously tested toolbar/modal flows still pass; no console errors on load.
rca_of_the_issue: Tooltip miss: ExifChip computes truncated = displayed.length > 22 while the rendered span is capped at max-w-[16ch], so values 17-22 chars are clipped without a title attribute.
